Your browser can also encode a real MP4 here — 5 seconds, 1080×1920, 30 fps, with the motion interpolated between the five key frames. It takes about 15 seconds and nothing leaves your device. The PNG frames stay available either way.
tools.wedding-video-invitation-maker.h2_: Why 5 key frames, and where the MP4 comes from
tools.wedding-video-invitation-maker.p_t: The tool draws its motion in 5 key frames (1080×1920, 9:16). Two downloads come out of that: the five PNG frames, and — when your browser can encode video — a real 5-second MP4 with the motion interpolated between the key frames at 30 fps.

The MP4 is encoded on your own device with the WebCodecs API. Nothing is uploaded, and there is no 30 MB ffmpeg.wasm to download. A browser that cannot encode H.264 simply keeps the PNG frames — you never lose the download either way.
